question: Which client segment consumed the least in September 2013?
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "consumption_with_segment" AS WITH t1 AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(SPLIT_PART(customerid_segment, '-', 1) AS INTEGER) AS customerid,
    TRIM(SPLIT_PART(customerid_segment, '-', 2)) AS segment
  FROM table_1
),
 t2 AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(customerid AS INTEGER) AS customerid,
    CAST(year AS INTEGER) AS year,
    CAST(month AS INTEGER) AS month,
    CAST(consumption AS DOUBLE) AS consumption
  FROM table_2
)
SELECT
  t1.customerid,
  t1.segment,
  t2.year,
  t2.month,
  t2.consumption
FROM t1
INNER JOIN t2 ON t1.customerid = t2.customerid

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "conductor_s_execution" AS
SELECT
  segment,
  SUM(consumption) AS total_consumption_sept_2013
FROM consumption_with_segment
WHERE CAST(year AS INTEGER) = 2013 AND CAST(month AS INTEGER) = 9
GROUP BY segment
ORDER BY total_consumption_sept_2013 ASC
LIMIT 1
